scientific_integrity: One unrestricted nonexistence classification over nine odd exponent layers; exact symbolic sieve with exhaustive finite integer certificates. Original polynomial and source identity credited.
scientific_limitations: Only d=9,11,...,25; no conclusions at larger odd or even exponents. Computation forms a finite proof component; no independent validation. Primary bibliographic source is the 2019 Fink arithmetic-function paper with 11A25 first-listed, while the 2020 Fink preprint develops pristine numbers.
title: Nine consecutive odd-exponent obstructions for pristine numbers
